Generating teams replaces the current roster and personal codes, and is disabled once a student submits. Enter one student per line under their team, using first and last names. Your GATOR3, GATOR4, GATOR5, and GATOR6 rooms already contain your assigned teams and four-digit codes. Do not click Generate teams in those rooms.

Teacher controls
